reviews.x: I have been using these headrest covers for over a year now and they work very well. They are just as good as the more expensive Earth lite brand. If they were about a 1/4 inch bigger they would be perfect! But great for the price. I definitely recommend these covers especially if you do a substantial amount of chair massage.

I received these face cradle covers a few days ago and not only am I pleased with the product but my clients are as well.  They are very soft unlike the usual rough paper covers I have received from other companies.  They have almost a flannel like feel.  Additionally, the sale price I paid was great and I received them only 2 maybe 3 days after I ordered them. Other companies I've had to wait almost a week in fact I'm still waiting for an order I placed with Massage Warehouse on the same day I

reviews.t: until we found out these are the same quality and always a better price. Our therapists and clients have noticed no ...
reviews.x: 5 stars for quality, dropped to 4 star because they are no longer prime eligible. I own a busy massage studio, we used to use earthlite, until we found out these are the same quality and always a better price. Our therapists and clients have noticed no difference. I would recommend these to anyone.

I've bought this product several times over the years and each cover has been perfect for it's specific use; however, this last order, the covers are about 1/2" shorter than those of the previous orders.  Since I usually order and receive them before I need them, i wasn't able to return them in time.  I just expected the dimensions to be the same.  I'll be trying another brand next time.

I loved the Earthlite covers but they are too expensive. I've ordered these from Therabuilt a few times now and they are pretty comparable to Earthlite. These covers are nice and soft and comfortable for my clients. At times they can be a bit linty and may have some imperfections (uneven trims) but they get the job done. They are great for the price! I will continue to purchase these.

I was concerned at first why this thing looks grey on the picture.. but the prices was good so I ordered them any way. and they are absolutely white. so I'm happy. they are soft and nice. were delivered very fast too so 5 stars!

reviews.t: doesn't feel like gift tissue paper
reviews.x: Just what I needed, cloth-like feel, doesn't feel like gift tissue paper, fits well into the face cradle, no smell or irritating feel.
wonderful my clients love these and the do the job just fine .. i cover my face cradle with a fleece pad then a flannel cover and use these over top one for each person..

I purchased these face cradle covers VERY last minute for an event.  They shipped quickly and very safely (came cross-country in 4 days).  The covers themselves are the softest I've ever used in my 5-year career as a massage therapist.  I HIGHLY recommend these covers.
wish the covers were a little bit bigger. so that no make up ends up on the headrest itself.
I really liked the fabric they used for the fact they are disposable. 100 is more than enough! Non crinckly and oil absorbant. Complaints: Shipping was as much as the product! ERG!
Good for the price.  I felt one and it didn't feel as thick as Earthlite brand that I have always bought,but wanted to try this one.  It will probably do.

Ugh, awful! Some reviews compared these to Earthlite covers and they are far from equivalent. They are super thin, cheap looking and poorly cut. It looks like Edward Scissorhands got crazy on them. They were delivered in a soft envelope and looked like someone ran over them on top of the poor quality.  Not impressed and if I were not almost out  of cradle covers, I would have returned them.

reviews.t: I thought they would completely cover the face cradle and ...
reviews.x: I thought they would completely cover the face cradle and slip around it, I was mistaken. They don't stay on- just always slipping off every time the client moves. Wish I knew where to buy the disposable ones that actually cover the face cradle completely

FYI, these headrest covers just lay on the headrest.  They do not wrap around the headrest with any elastic or attachment. That being said, I do agree that they are very soft & large enough to cover various size headrests.  I'm fine with them.

These are very soft, which is great!  Also, durable and thicker than I expected.  They are a little wider than my face cradle is, though, so they don't lie flat and they leave creases on my client's faces.
Great value for the money!  These are soft, pliable and do not seem to stick to my clients faces like other products that I have used.  I will be purchasing these again!

reviews.t: Soft and feels great for my clients
reviews.x: Soft and feels great for my clients. It helps because sometimes female clients would stain my washable head covers with their make-up. I can put it over or replace it.
Best value I've seen in 20 years.  Sheets still too expensive, but I would use these on both chair and table clients without regret.
Serves the purpose, my wife is a Sports Massage Therapist and goes through these pretty fast (thankfully since it means customers).

reviews.t: Good Product, Price/Value & Sufficient Thickness as well
reviews.x: Good Product, Price/Value & Sufficient Thickness as well... I Like the Couple of $$$ More Competitor's Product a Little Better !
Smaller than the Earthlite disposable face cradlet covers. Completely underwhelming performance when compared to Earthlite.

reviews.t: Comfortable and No cloth lines or marks on client !
reviews.x: Pro: soft; comfortable; no facial lines or marks on client Con: no elastic to keep still for client.
the material felt a bit like polyester and not as thick as the earthlite brand, but it's cheaper!
These are flimsy. They blow off the face cradle with only breath.  No likey.

claims.text: Customers frequently describe the covers as soft and comfortable, often comparing them favorably to flannel or noting they don't feel like paper.
Many reviewers find them a good value and comparable to the pricier Earthlite brand, though a few disagree on the quality comparison.
Some customers report sizing issues, saying the covers are too short or too small to fully cover the face cradle.
Several reviewers note the covers are thin and may have imperfections like uneven trims or lint.
A few customers mention the covers don't stay attached and slip off the headrest since they lack elastic or wrapping.
